memory_annotations.evidence_summary: After business-class options were surfaced, Marcus explicitly selected coach only for this short Dallas trip because the premium was not worthwhile, providing a trip-local exception to the business-class preference.

messages.content: I need a nonstop round trip from Chicago to Dallas for a leadership meeting. It starts Tuesday at 1:00 p.m. and ends Thursday at noon. I can fly out Tuesday morning and back Thursday afternoon.
What are the exact dates, and can you use either Chicago airport and either Dallas airport?
April 14 through April 16, 2026. Either Chicago airport is fine. The organizer still hasn't sent the hotel or meeting venue, so prioritize an arrival that gives me a reliable buffer.

The strongest nonstop pair is American from ORD to DFW: Tuesday 7:25 a.m.-10:04 a.m., returning Thursday 3:40 p.m.-6:08 p.m. Round trip is $1,084 in business or $492 in Main Cabin. United has an 8:05 a.m.-10:42 a.m. outbound and 4:10 p.m.-6:42 p.m. return for $1,146 in business or $468 in economy. A $421 American itinerary arrives at 11:49 a.m., which is too exposed for a 1:00 p.m. start.
For this Dallas trip, put me in coach. The business premium isn't worthwhile on flights this short. Which coach fare is the better fit once the timing and terms are considered?

I recommend the $492 American Main Cabin itinerary. It arrives 38 minutes earlier than United and returns sooner. Changes have no airline fee, though a fare difference can apply; cancellation before departure produces an American trip credit. The ticket is not refundable to the original payment method.
Confirm the ground-time assumptions on both ends before I buy it.

With a 10:04 a.m. landing, a reasonable estimate is curbside by 10:35. Even allowing an hour to reach a central Dallas venue puts you there around 11:35, about 85 minutes early. On Thursday, leaving the meeting by 12:15 should get you to DFW near 1:15, leaving roughly two hours before departure. We should recheck both estimates when the venue is confirmed.
That works. Purchase the $492 Main Cabin round trip using the company Visa ending in 4412.

Purchased for $492 on the Visa ending in 4412. American confirmation: K7R4LM. You are booked ORD-DFW on Tuesday, April 14, departing 7:25 a.m. and arriving 10:04 a.m.; the return leaves DFW Thursday, April 16, at 3:40 p.m. and reaches ORD at 6:08 p.m. The fare can be changed without an airline fee or canceled for trip credit before departure.

updated_continuity_summary: Dallas leadership meeting trip is active for April 14-16, 2026. Estimated Tuesday curbside time is 10:35 a.m.; Thursday target departure from the meeting is 12:15 p.m. Hotel and meeting venue remain unresolved, and ground-transfer estimates should be checked when the organizer confirms them.
